# max-snippet

*Directive*

A robots rule that caps the length of a page's text snippet in Google results, in characters.

**Glossary** (*max-snippet*): A robots rule that caps a snippet at a number of characters: 0 means no snippet and -1 means no limit. It also limits how much of the page AI features may use.

Narrative: the topic [Snippets and preview controls](../topics/snippet-controls.md) tells the story; this card lists what links to it.

10 claims mention it: 2 from Google's documentation, 5 shown or said at the event (2 not in Google docs, 2 confirmed by Google docs, 1 consistent with Google docs), 3 the author's analysis. A card is a map: cite the claim ids, with the citation given after each claim.

## Google's documentation

Documented in: [Robots meta tag, data-nosnippet, and X-Robots-Tag specifications](https://developers.google.com/search/docs/crawling-indexing/robots-meta-tag).

- [`D2-C086`](../sessions/D2-S04-controlling-indexing.md) Docs: Google's robots meta tag specification says Google chooses the snippet length when no max-snippet rule is set, and with max-snippet:-1 chooses the length it believes most effective; it does not say that -1 produces longer snippets. `[D2-C086, docs, Google Search Central, https://developers.google.com/search/docs/crawling-indexing/robots-meta-tag]`
- [`D2-C728`](../sessions/D2-S23-how-does-the-index-look-like.md) Docs: Google's robots meta tag specification says the nosnippet rule also prevents a page's content from being used as a direct input for AI Overviews and AI Mode, and max-snippet also limits how much of it may be used that way. `[D2-C728, docs, Google Search Central, https://developers.google.com/search/docs/crawling-indexing/robots-meta-tag]`

## Shown or said at the event

Not in Google's documentation first: present those as said at Search Central Live, never as documented policy.

- [`D2-C084`](../sessions/D2-S04-controlling-indexing.md) Stage, Day 2, not in Google docs: A max-snippet value too short for a useful snippet may lead Google to show no snippet at all, John Mueller said. `[D2-C084, stage, John Mueller, Day 2]`
- [`D2-C085`](../sessions/D2-S04-controlling-indexing.md) Slide, Day 2, not in Google docs: max-snippet:-1 removes the length limit and can produce a longer snippet than having no rule, because by default Google keeps snippets to a length it considers reasonable instead of quoting a page at length. `[D2-C085, slide, John Mueller, Day 2]`
- [`D2-C082`](../sessions/D2-S04-controlling-indexing.md) Slide, Day 2, confirmed by Google docs: The max-snippet:[number] rule limits a page's search result snippet to that number of characters (100 characters, for example), and max-snippet:0 shows no snippet, the same as nosnippet. `[D2-C082, slide, John Mueller, Day 2]`
- [`D2-C083`](../sessions/D2-S04-controlling-indexing.md) Stage, Day 2, confirmed by Google docs: John Mueller said, hedging with 'I think', that the max-snippet limit also applies to AI Overviews and AI Mode. `[D2-C083, stage, John Mueller, Day 2]`
- [`D2-C104`](../sessions/D2-S04-controlling-indexing.md) Slide, Day 2, consistent with Google docs: To be as visible as possible in Google, John Mueller's closing slide recommended the robots rules max-image-preview:large and max-snippet:-1. `[D2-C104, slide, John Mueller, Day 2]`

## The author's analysis

- [`D2-C075`](../sessions/D2-S04-controlling-indexing.md) Analysis: Before adding nosnippet or a low max-snippet value, weigh the cost in AI features: both limit how much of the page AI Overviews and AI Mode can use, and John Mueller described those answers as built from snippets. `[D2-C075, analysis, Ibrahim Anjro]`
- [`D2-C105`](../sessions/D2-S04-controlling-indexing.md) Analysis: Set max-snippet:-1 and max-image-preview:large on every indexable template unless licensing requires otherwise, and check that no CMS, plug-in or CDN setting adds lower snippet or image preview limits by default. `[D2-C105, analysis, Ibrahim Anjro]`
- [`D2-C731`](../sessions/D2-S23-how-does-the-index-look-like.md) Analysis: Treat nosnippet, data-nosnippet and max-snippet as AI visibility settings too: Google lists them as the controls for content in AI features, and if AI answers are built from index snippets, as Google said on stage, a blocked or shortened snippet leaves AI Overviews and AI Mode less to use. `[D2-C731, analysis, Ibrahim Anjro]`

## For developers

- `DEV-IDX-04` **SHOULD** · Documented: Allow full snippets and large previews with max-snippet:-1 and max-image-preview:large (4 of its claims mention it; its own text names it)
- `DEV-IDX-05` **AVOID** · Documented: Do not add nosnippet or a short max-snippet unless you accept losing snippets and AI feature use (2 of its claims mention it; its own text names it)
